text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――Surely, someone once had a "dream."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—If Tanino Gimlet ever runs in the Arima 
Kinen..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If there were an opportunity to compete 
with all our heart and soul against rivals 
from Symboli Kris S's generation—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"How far can Tanino Gimlet go? Will she be 
able to secure victory even at the 
grueling 2,500m distance?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume Tanino Gimlet is someone you 
simply cannot ignore once you've heard a 
dream like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because she is a 'Goddess of Destruction' 
who passionately loves chaos—and every 
single possibility that permeates this 
world."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaa-hahahahaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tremble, Nakayama at year's end! Behold 
this God of Destruction unleash the 
absolute limits of tyranny upon the stage 
where dreams gather!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, it's finally sinking in! Gimlet is 
seriously running in this year's Arima 
Kinen...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If she wins this, it's the Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown...! Even though she already 
won the Yasuda Kinen this year, that's 
just insane! She truly is a "God of 
Destruction"!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Man, you sure know how to put on a flashy 
show every time! Taking on any distance 
with that level of crazy—I gotta say, I 
love it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"So long as I desire it, I am omnipresent 
across all places. Distance is virtually 
meaningless to me."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
So, you're paying back your debt right 
away? Tap Dance City.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah! I'm gonna blow right past 'em 
at top speed!! Burn my romance into your 
eyes!!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Then by all means, allow me to 
relish your romantic ideal to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—At times, the "Hero" stands before a god 
wielding mighty authority, proving their 
worth as a hero through sheer courage.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As one who aspires to be a "Hero"— I shall 
challenge you today, the "God of 
Destruction"...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(One who walks the steep path of a hero— 
She should still be just a Classic-tier 
Umamusume, yet what pure, unadulterated 
madness dwells in her eyes...!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Take up your sword, Zenno Rob Roy. Show 
me a radiance that outshines even the 
gleaming blade. That is all I desire from 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I believe I understand just how much 
Gimlet-san means to you, Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
However, today—I will not yield. For this 
race must show that person the beginning 
of a hero...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The blade harbored within my very soul— I 
shall surely show it to you!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! That's the spirit!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, what a world―― so full of brilliance, 
and so ripe for ruin.)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(I'm getting exhilarated...! If I destroy 
all of this and rebuild it— just how much 
chaos will it spawn...!?)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――Shoot without mercy.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"For today, I have come to face you—my 
greatest 'ordeal.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Of course. However—do not forget—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Those running today—are all strong. Not 
a single one—can be taken lightly.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, without a doubt. I stand here 
prepared to be utterly trampled by every 
single soul present...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—The flashes of brilliance from gathered 
heroes. Allow me to savor it to the 
fullest...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Come, let us begin, Kris S!! Our bloody 
battle of frenzy, where our destinies and 
dreams intertwine!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...That's the spirit.
